summary: West kerb of Taringa Parade backing onto bush, where cars already park.

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush behind the verge; the nearest house on this side is about 26 m south, others across the road 24 m or more.
drivers.access_and_room: Gravel verge wide enough for a van, with two cars already parked on it.
drivers.traffic: Through street with moderate traffic; the van stands clear of the lane on the verge.
drivers.convention: Cars park on this verge in both images, so a van will not stand out.

sun_shade: Bush canopy shades from the west and afternoon; open to morning sun over the road.

best_section.where: West side of Taringa Parade, opposite the corner with the side street, beside the bush
